regime_tldr.content: **Cautiously bullish with improving headline, but Iran tail risk not fully resolved.** S&P 500 hit a new ATH of 7,259.22 (+0.81%) and Nasdaq a record 25,326.13 (+1.03%) on May 5. May 6 futures are positive as US-Iran ceasefire/deal talks advance, pushing oil lower (WTI easing toward ~$102 from a $104+ peak). The macro regime is upgrading from "mixed-to-cautiously-bullish" to **cautiously bullish**: earnings are providing a genuine near-term tailwind, and geopolitical risk is partially easing. However, the Iran conflict is not resolved, Fed leadership transition on May 15 adds policy uncertainty, and inflation remains elevated. Growth stocks (NVDA, META, AAPL) remain most sensitive to rate-tightening tail risk. [source: web_research/NVDA.json macro_context, run 20260506_123913]
